Nadia: Looping in finance + platform. BridgeWorks sent a renewal proposal for our ingestion connector. They have three billing models. Need quick sanity-check and a list of must-have contract asks.

Owen: Paste the proposals? will run simple $/1k-call and $/1M-token normals.

Nadia: Hereare their summary: 
```
Plan 1 (Seat): $95/user/month, minimum 6 users.
Plan 2 (Commit): $0.03 per 1k API calls, volume tiers: 0-250k, 250k-1M (10% off), 1M+ (20% off). 12mo prepay gives additional 12% discount.
Plan 3 (Hybrid): $60/user/month + $0.01 per 1k calls after a 150k calls/month included bucket.
Security add-on: Private deployment + AWS KMS = $9k/year.
Embed compute: $40 per 1M tokens (or included in custom token bundles).
Termination: 6mo notification + buyout equal to 50% remaining commit unless annual.
```

Rina: Our telemetry: ~6.5k API calls/day (~195k/mo), seats needed = 7, monthly embedding ingestion ~1.8M tokens.

Owen: Rough numbers annualized:
- Plan1: seats = 7*$95*12 = $7,980/yr; add embed 1.8M*$40/1M*12? wait embed is per month: 1.8M tokens/mo = 21.6M/yr => if billed monthly at $40/1M tokens that's 21.6*$40 = $864/yr? That seems off. Recalc: 1.8M tokens/mo = 1.8*12 = 21.6M tokens/yr; cost = 21.6 * $40 = $864. Actually $864/year - yes. Total ~ $8,844/yr.
- Plan2: calls 195k/mo = 2.34M/yr; at $0.03/1k = 2,340 * $0.03 = $70.2/mo => $842.4/yr; wait math mismatch because $0.03 per 1k * 2,340 (1k units) = $70.2/mo = $842.4/yr. Add embed 21.6M*$40 = $864 => total ~$1,706/yr. With tier discounts and 12mo prepay it's even cheaper.
- Plan3: seats 7*$60*12 = $5,040 + calls over 150k bucket: our calls 195k -> overage 45k/mo => 45 * $0.01 *12 = $5.4/mo? careful: 45k calls = 45 *1k units -> 45* $0.01 = $0.45/mo -> that seems tiny. So annual overage = $5.4. Embeds $864 -> total ~$5,909.
So Plan2 looks way cheaper given our call volume vs seat counts and cheap embed rate.

Nadia: Great context. Two immediate contract asks: 1) Clarify how "API call" is measured (batch vs individual), 2) Is embedding compute included in token bundles, and if so what's granularity? Also we must insist on DPA + SOC2 + right to audit.

Leo (BridgeWorks): Quick clarifications: API call = per HTTP request. Batched embedding requests count per individual item for billing. We offer token bundles starting at 5M tokens with 10% off; otherwise $40/1M applies. Private + KMS is available; we can include SOC2 Type II report and summary of recent pen test. Termination buyout is negotiable for enterprise customers.

Maya (Legal): Do not accept a buyout clause that effectively locks us in. Need a cap and a right to transition with pro-rata refunds. Require standard indemnities, export restrictions, and a security appendix. Also confirm data residency for private deployments.

Owen: One more ask: can they provide a modeled quote for 12mo commit at 250k/mo and 500k/mo so we can see marginal savings if we scale? And request exact token pricing in the quote (monthly and annual).

Nadia: I'll request the tiered quotes + SOC2 + sample DPA + explicit definition of "call" and batching calc. Also propose a 12mo initial term with auto-convert to month-to-month after 12 unless we commit to 24mo, and a 30-day termination right with limited penalties.

procure-bot: Ticket created VB-3499: bridgeworks-renewal-modeling - assigned to @Nadia. https://tickets.internal/VB-3499

Rina: One technical note: for PII flows we must ensure Private supports HSM-backed key rotation and on-prem connector. Mark that as redline item.

Leo (BridgeWorks): Understood. Will send itemized quote and security docs by EOD tomorrow.

Maya (Legal): I'll standby to review T&Cs when they arrive.
